top_signals.title: Nomura Says Three Straight BOJ Hikes Possible in Extreme Case
top_signals.summary: The Bank of Japan could raise interest rates at three consecutive meetings through December in an extreme scenario where yen weakness persists, according to Nomura Securities Co.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Ferrari’s Charles Leclerc still dreaming of Formula One title
top_signals.summary: The 28-year-old said in an interview in August that it "is still possible" for him to become world champion in 2027, although it will be "surely a difficult goal to achieve."
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Toyota weighs hydrogen power for trucks that ship auto parts
top_signals.summary: Toyota has long touted hydrogen as an option alongside combustion engines, gas-electric hybrids and battery electric vehicles, as part of the automaker's "multipathway approach."
